title: Solidly Built But With Some Design Issues
text:
Solidly Built But With Some Design Issues. The tumbler itself seems solidly built and durable, which is nice. However, there are some design issues with it. The size of the tumbler is one of those issues. I wear a large in men's gloves and the cup is still a bit awkward for me to hold. Even worse, the outside of the tumbler gets slippery when wet. Most water bottles have a handle you can hold onto them with, but not this one. I haven't dropped it yet, but that seems to be just a matter of time.

The slider on the lid you push open to pour out liquids is easy to leave open without noticing you did. That lets bugs in and doesn't help with the insulation. Speaking of the insulation, it does not keep liquids cool for very long. Ice water will go from cold to mildly cool in an hour or so. There are plenty of insulated bottles on the market. This is not one I would get again.

product_metadata.title: Insulated Tumblers, 30 oz Stainless Steel Tumbler with Lid Double Wall Travel Water Bottle Cup Coffee Mug for Ice and Hot Beverage
features: 18/8 Stainless Steel: Insulated tumbler made from kitchen-grade 18/8 stainless steel, the tumbler is vacuum-insulated to better keep your hot drinks steaming and your cold drinks packed with ice even after hours.

Double-Walled: The insulated drink mug has a double-walled design, retains ice and heat twice as long as other tumblers, for durability that stays comfortable to the touch, no matter how hot its contents.

Lid Prevents Splashes: Insulated tumbler includes a plastic lid. The wide mouth has a clear, push-on sliding lid to prevent spills and leaks. There is a straw hole on lid,which is also great for sipping and stirring your favorite chunky fruit smoothie.

30 oz Tumbler for Travel: The narrow design is convenient for traveling (7.7 inches high with a 2.8-inch diameter at bottom) because it easily fits in most cup holders. With 30 oz capacity, you can easily take your favorite beverage on the go.

Colors Available: This tumbler cup is available in a number of colors, including orange, violet, pink, dark green, rose, yellow, light green, coral, black, blue and red. Easy to clean, just stick it in the dishwasher for a quick clean-up.
